needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide urban street.
Install street lighting along the urban road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
